text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I shall begin my undercover 
investigation mission at the "Bad Boy 
Cafe"!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
""Bad Boy Café"—a concept café that 
recently opened in front of the station. 
The idea is that both the staff and 
customers spend their time acting like 
rebellious bad boys."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ever since it opened, it's gained huge 
popularity... It seems to be quite a trend 
among the Tracen Academy students as well.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
However, is that cafe truly safe? Or might 
there be youths so engrossed in it that it 
affects their personal lives...?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"To properly grasp the true situation, I 
must first blend into this cafe! This 
officer shall thoroughly play the villain, 
sir!"

text_block_list.name: Delinquent-Looking Clerk
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, welc—whoa there. Well now... from 
the look of ya, I'd say you've got quite 
the tales of valor. Table in the back's 
open."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Alright... looks like they took me for a 
bad guy. At this rate, I'll blend right 
into the cafe and conduct a thorough 
investigation, sir!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent-Looking Clerk
text_block_list.text:
It's "Legitimate Tropical Juice." Heh, 
this is just about right for a coward like 
you. Well, why don't you enjoy it?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Wha! What outrageous behavior! This is 
purely delinquent conduct, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Hah! T-That is correct, sir... What we 
must do right now is an undercover 
investigation... which means, yes, 
becoming totally bad...! Bad to the 
bone...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... I will eat this hamburger 
steak using only a fork and relieve the 
knife of its duties, yes sir!
choice_data_list:
...Whoa, that would make even table 
manners blush...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, I mixed drinks at the drink bar, 
sir! Orange juice and carbonated water!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent-Looking Clerk
text_block_list.text:
You want the secret menu's Diabolical 
Pound Steak...? Then show me your most 
villainous feat of heroism!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Bring it on...! Last night, I drank milk 
after brushing my teeth!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...Even though I had to brush my teeth 
all over again, making double the work! 
Sir, yes sir!"
choice_data_list:
...If they polished it back up in the end, 
isn't that a good kid?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Grrr... Th-then...! I once bought and ate 
sweet red bean buns after roadwork! And... 
three of them, no less!!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent-Looking Clerk
text_block_list.text: ...Are you guys kidding me?

text_block_list.name: Thug A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, a "Bad Boy Café", eh...? Haha, talk 
about playing house. How lame.

text_block_list.name: Thug B
text_block_list.text:
'Sup. Hey, the badder you are, the better 
here, right? Then how 'bout this—if I beat 
the crap outta all your staff, you gonna 
give me my meal on the house?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
That doesn't... look like an ordinary 
customer who's just here to enjoy the 
concept, does it?
choice_data_list:
...Yeah, you're right. We should probably 
report this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Judging by the staff's reactions, getting 
the person in charge will take some time. 
Perhaps I should discreetly call 110..."

text_block_list.name: Thug A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Hey, you over there. Whatcha doing, 
calling the cops on me or something?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've been spotted. The thugs forcibly 
snatch my smartphone away.

text_block_list.name: Thug B
text_block_list.text:
Haaah? We're just regular customers here, 
y'know. Besides, this ain't your business. 
Back off!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was shoved hard in the shoulder— And the 
split-second I braced for the pain...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—Please step back, Boss. ...I will draw 
them away.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: You insolent fools!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Halt right there!! Not only do you cause 
trouble for the shop—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
To harm my precious Boss...! I will never, 
ever forgive this!!

text_block_list.name: Thug A
text_block_list.text: Eep...!! Ugh, th-this guy...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Intimidated by Fenomeno's powerful, 
furious shout, the punk recoils. Clatter— 
the stolen smartphone falls and rolls 
across the ground.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I quickly grab my smartphone and call the 
police. I'm grateful to Fenomeno for 
creating an opening for me... but from 
here on out, it's a job for the adults!
choice_data_list:
Thanks, Meno. It's alright now, I've 
already reported it.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —! ...As expected of you, Boss.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—The police will be arriving shortly. 
Reflect deeply on your actions and 
surrender peacefully!

text_block_list.name: Thug B
text_block_list.text:
Guh…… uuugh…… m-my legs gave out…… I can't 
move…… dammit…….

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The arriving police officers hauled the 
thugs away... and after a brief 
questioning on the spot, we were let go as 
well."
choice_data_list: Either way, I'm just glad Meno isn't hurt.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
............My heart skipped a beat 
earlier. The thought of you getting hurt 
was just............

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her courage is a rare and precious 
quality. I'm also grateful she shielded me 
when I almost fell. Even so, recklessly 
getting involved in trouble is—
choice_data_list:
It's dangerous, so I'd prefer if you 
refrained as much as possible.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I apologize. I lost my temper for a 
moment... I will take this to heart and 
act with greater caution in the future.
choice_data_list:
Yeah... Thank you. I'm just glad we're 
both safe.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes—the shop didn't suffer any major 
damage, which is a relief, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I hear they're stepping up their crime 
prevention measures following this. Their 
concept may be "evil," but the shop's 
management is quite earnest.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I conclude that "Bad Boy Café" 
is safe. Investigation complete, Boss!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, there is one more point to 
reflect upon. I ended up frightening not 
only the thugs, but the shop staff and 
other customers as well."
choice_data_list:
Still, the fact remains that Meno 
protected everyone.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, I am glad that no one was 
injured and everyone is safe, sir.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
However, we need to carefully consider 
whether this shop is safe for students. I 
will take this matter back to the 
Disciplinary Committee!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes—the shop didn't suffer any major 
damage, which is a relief, sir!
choice_data_list:
So, how did the undercover investigation 
go?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Yes! The investigation results are... ————

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Nuwaaah!! I was so focused on acting bad, 
I forgot to take notes!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
What a blunder!! A re-investigation is 
required~~!
